summary: Morgan Stanley Capital I Trust 2018-H3 filed an 8-K reporting the appointment of Torchlight Loan Services, LLC as special servicer for the Griffin Portfolio II mortgage loan, replacing Mount Street US (Georgia) LLP. The change was directed by Deer Park Road Management Company, LP, the directing certificateholder under the BANK 2018-BNK13 PSA. No financial terms, stake, price, premium, or board recommendation were disclosed. This is a routine servicing arrangement for a commercial mortgage-backed security trust. The filing does not reflect a corporate transaction, activist campaign, or other special situation. What to watch: no material impact expected; trust administration continues per the pooling and servicing agreement.
